name: Shandong Xiantan Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Xiantan Group Co., Ltd. engages in parent and commercial broiler breeder farming, chick hatching, feed production, and broiler slaughtering businesses in China and internationally. The company offers broiler chicken meat and commercial broiler chicken products. It also sells its products under the Xiantan and Xianrun brands. The company was formerly known as Shandong Xiantan Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shandong Xiantan Group Co., Ltd. in November 2025. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Yantai, China.
